verdict.rationale: Auth0 publishes a dedicated 'Auth0 AI' developer surface (auth0.com/ai/docs) covering agent-facing capabilities like Universal Login for agents, Token Vault, CIBA step-up, and FGA for RAG, plus an official MCP server and CLI that let AI-native developers build/manage against Auth0 programmatically (auth0-docs-15/16/17/18/19/20, auth0-docs-41, auth0-gh-1, auth0-probe-4/5). However the evidence never names concrete language SDK packages (e.g., a Node/Python 'Auth0 AI SDK') or shows independent developer confirmation that these SDKs work as documented. Missing for 10: explicit SDK package/documentation references for AI-agent integration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
